name: TOML Formatter
description: Pretty-print, minify or validate TOML text.

results.outputHint: The result can be copied directly.
results.commentsLostHint: The TOML parser does not keep comments, so the reformatted content no longer contains them.

hints.input: TOML only has key/value pairs and tables, so indentation only affects how table headers are laid out, never the meaning.
hints.action: Validate only reports whether the syntax is legal; it does not rewrite the content.
hints.indent: The indent width is measured in spaces; 2, 4 and 8 are available.
hints.output: Format puts every table header on its own line; minify drops blank lines.

faq.q: Why does the result report lost comments?
faq.a: The TOML parser does not store comment information, so the reformatted content naturally has none. The tool flags it explicitly so you do not overwrite your original file by accident.
Date-times are emitted per the TOML specification, for example `1979-05-27T07:32:00Z`; the meaning is unchanged.
Only blank lines and trailing whitespace; everything else is kept as is.
